text:
Plant Club boxes ship in the **first full week of each month**.

Some related timing that may help:
- You're charged on the **25th** of the previous month.
- Changes (skip, pause, plan change or cancel) made before the 25th affect the next box. Changes on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box, and an already-billed box is still sent and not refunded on cancellation.

You can manage your subscription under "Account" > "Subscriptions". Is there anything else I can help with?
